relevant.auth_session: API: plugins/auth.ts sets req.user (PublicUser|null) in onRequest from cookie 'frisson_session' (opaque token, sha256 hash stored in sessions table; services/sessions.ts findSessionUser). Require a user: requireUser(req.user) in services/permissions.ts:16 (401), used as route preValidation (routes/profiles.ts:~20); requireAdmin also there; canEditOwner/assertCanEditCrate. Web: GET /api/auth/me (routes/auth.ts:73) -> session store (stores/session.ts): user, loaded, signedIn, isAdmin, load(), logIn/signUp/logOut/refresh. publicUser has id,email,username,displayName,role,avatarUrl,verified.
relevant.db_schema: apps/api/src/db/schema.ts. users (:21-34): id, email, username, displayName, passwordHash, role(user|admin), createdAt, bio, location, avatarPath, verified. user_links, sessions. crates (:68-80): id, name, color, label, sortBy, sortOrder, ownerId (nullable FK users, set null), created/updated. NO visibility/public/private field on crates (all crates public via GET /api/crates). albums: crateId (restrict), title, artist, year, genre, format, coverPath, sleeveColor, rating, notes, position, spinCount. tracks: albumId, side A-D, position, title, durationSec. No follows/news/recommendation tables.

relevant.seed: apps/api/src/db/seed.ts, run ONLY manually via `npm run db:seed -w apps/api` (apps/api/package.json:11; README:79). NOT run on server start, not in Dockerfile/compose/CI. It is a DESTRUCTIVE script: refuses if NODE_ENV=production; rm -rf DEFAULT_COVERS_DIR; in one transaction deletes all tracks, albums, crates (users untouched) and re-inserts. No skip-if-seeded guard; every run wipes crates. Data: const SEED = [{name,label,color,albums:[{title,artist,year,genre,rating,sleeveColor,notes?,sides?:{A:[titles],B:..}}]}] -- 2 crates ('Guitars' 4 albums, 'Beats & Bass' 6 albums), 10 albums; tracks only as title lists per side (no durations); no coverPath (generated sleeves); crates inserted WITHOUT ownerId (null = legacy; bootstrap assigns to admin only when server starts with ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD, services/bootstrap.ts bootstrapFromEnv, called in src/server.ts:10 each start). Seed creates no users, no avatars. DB lives at <repo>/data/crate.db (paths.ts; data/ has avatars, covers, crate.db).
relevant.seed_wipe_hazard: Re-running seed deletes ALL crates/albums including any user-created ones and any new seeded content has to be added inside this wipe script or a new idempotent script; deleting crates also leaves users' ownership irrelevant. Seeded users would need createUser (services/users.ts) which hashes password.
relevant.avatar_handling: avatarPath stores public URL path '/avatars/<file>' (services/avatars.ts:21,72); files in data/avatars served by plugins/avatars.ts static. UserAvatar.vue falls back to initials when avatarUrl null, so seeded fake users need no image files.
relevant.cover_rendering: apps/web/src/components/crate/SleeveArt.vue: if album.coverPath -> (served from /covers/ by plugins/covers.ts); else generated sleeve using sleeveColor background, readableInk(utils/color.ts) text, and a motif picked by album.id % 4 ('rings','stripes','sun','grid'), with edge strip + sticker showing title/artist/year. So seeded albums need only sleeveColor (hex) + title/artist/year. Crate color/label drive CrateBox tape labels (utils/crateLayout.ts).
